diagnosis: The previous recipe built successfully but is missing prop-types.js and prop-types.min.js. These are not source files in the repo; they are generated at publish time by the `build` script (`yarn umd && yarn umd-min`, using browserify/uglifyify), which is wired up via the legacy `prepublish` script (`not-in-publish || yarn build`). Modern npm (8.3.0 included) no longer runs the deprecated `prepublish` hook automatically for `npm pack`/`npm publish` — only `prepare`/`prepack`/`prepublishOnly` are invoked, and this package defines none of those. So `npm pack` alone silently skips generating the UMD bundles, producing a tarball that is missing two files present in the real published artifact. The fix is to explicitly build the UMD bundles (installing devDependencies so browserify/uglifyify/uglifyjs are available) before packing, rather than relying on an npm lifecycle hook that no longer fires.
